dedupe_keys.name: principal mineral areas producing mines and oil and gas fields map 900a

description: Map 900A is produced and published every year by Natural Resources Canada. It contains statistics on Canada's mineral production and the locations of significant metallic, nonmetallic and coal mines, oil sands mines, selected metallurgical works, helium facilities and oil and gas fields across the provinces and territories. The current edition covers 2025 (catalogue record modified 27 February 2026). It is available as a file geodatabase, shapefiles, a PDF map, ArcMap project files, an ESRI REST map service and OGC WMS in English and French, and in the Atlas of Canada Minerals and Mining web map, which also shows the companion Top 100 Exploration Projects layer. All are free under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Caveats: the map shows significant operations only, not every mine, and attributes are yearly snapshots. For simulation it is a national asset inventory of mines, processing works and oil and gas fields for exposure, supply-chain and interdependency studies. Related catalogue records include NRCan's critical minerals dataset, the USGS MRDS and the OZMIN database.
